author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a capsule handle upper-right, a straight shank along the same diagonal, and a triangular blade pointing to the lower-left corner with its base square to the axis, as in the reference. The rejected drawing had a small trapezoid handle, a kinked shank and a heavy triangle.
omissions: The small crank (jog) in the shank and the tang line drawn over the blade are dropped: at 48px the tang sits closer than 8 units to the blade edge and the jog is sub-stroke.
lucide_reference: No Lucide trowel glyph; capsule handle on a diagonal axis as in Lucide 'paintbrush'.
